newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BOLGER ASKS DELAMERE TO BE ACTING CUSTOMS MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: BOLGER ASKS DELAMERE TO BE ACTING CUSTOMS MINISTER.

text.p: New Zealand Prime Minister Jim Bolger confirmed on Thursday that New Zealand First's Tuariki John Delamere would be offered the post of Customs Minister following the dismissal of Neil Kirton earlier in the day.
In a statement distributed from his office, Bolger said "I have asked Tuariki John Delamere to act as minister of customs."
Kirton was also Associate Minister of Health, and Bolger said, "I do not propose to appoint a new Associate Minister of Health immediately.".
